title: CryptoShares
tagline: A web3 based platform which allows founders to list their startups and other investors to buy shares and fund the startup
description: Introducing our groundbreaking web3-based platform designed to revolutionize the way startups connect with investors: CryptoShares. This innovative platform facilitates an open and transparent ecosystem where founders can showcase their startups, set share prices, and attract funding from a global community of investors. Founders register their startups, providing comprehensive details such as share prices and stock values, and investors can seamlessly participate in secure and transparent transactions. CryptoShares is where innovation converges with investment, creating an inclusive and decentralized future for fundraising.
how_its_made:
This project uses ConnectKit to implement a wallet functionality in the app and provide as a authentication layer and allows users to seemingly transfer Crypto to founders and invest.
This project is made using React.js and is Hosted in Firebase and uses Firebase Firestore.
ConnectKit helped us to provide a easy way for users to connect with their wallet and transfer funds and also as a way of authentication
